guaranteeCopy: We guarantee private fillings, crowns and bridges for 2 years, and implants for 5 years, against failure through no fault of your own. Ask your dentist to confirm the guarantee for your treatment in writing before it starts.
planCopy: If you would rather pay a fixed amount each month, ask about our private membership plan. It covers two check-ups and a scale and polish a year, plus a discount on any further treatment, for a set monthly fee.
